## Checklist

### For New Tool Additions

- [ ] Tool is actively maintained (last commit within 6 months)
- [ ] Tool has a clear README/documentation
- [ ] I have personally used or thoroughly tested this tool
- [ ] Tool is not already listed in the repository
- [ ] Added tool to the appropriate category file
- [ ] Updated README.md tools table

### For Documentation Changes

- [ ] Fixed typos or grammar
- [ ] Updated outdated information
- [ ] Added missing details
- [ ] Maintained bilingual (English + Chinese) where applicable

### General

- [ ] My changes follow the project's style guide
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] I have updated documentation as needed
- [ ] My commits follow conventional commit format
